verdict.rationale:
Docs explicitly cover custom tools (letting developers define their own functions Claude can call), permission callbacks, structured outputs with schema validation, and the SDK's tool/agent loop infrastructure — together enabling defining agents with typed custom tools concisely in Python/TypeScript. The community evidence is unrelated to this axis (billing/policy complaints) and doesn't contradict the capability itself.
